title: High-throughput screening for agonists of ROS production in live human vascular endothelial cells
author: Sasahara, Hoshi
materials: Wheat germ agglutinin Alexa Fluor 488 conjugate

steps.title: Prepare cells and stock solutions
steps.instruction: Culture human vascular endothelial cells and prepare stock solutions of the fluorescent cell‑membrane marker, ROS inhibitors, and lipopolysaccharide (LPS) before starting the assay.

steps.title: Coat plates with collagen‑I
steps.instruction: Prepare pH 3.0 distilled water, filter it (0.22 µm PVDF), dilute collagen‑I ten‑fold in this water, add 3 mL to a 100‑mm dish and 40 µL to each well of a flat‑bottom 96‑well plate, incubate 1 h at 22–25 °C, rinse three times with calcium‑ and magnesium‑free PBS (PBS(–)), add 8 mL (dish) or 50 µL (well) of PBS(–), and store at 4 °C (use within 24 h).

substeps.instruction: Adjust distilled water to pH 3.0 with HCl and a pH meter.
Sterilize the pH‑adjusted water by passing it through a 0.22 µm PVDF filter.
Dilute collagen‑I ten‑fold in the pH 3.0 water.
Add 3 mL of diluted collagen‑I to a 100‑mm culture dish and 40 µL to each well of a 96‑well plate.
Incubate the coated surfaces for 1 h at 22–25 °C.
Rinse the dish and plate three times with PBS(–).
Add 8 mL (dish) or 50 µL (well) of PBS(–) and store at 4 °C; use within 24 h.

steps.title: Thaw and seed endothelial cells
steps.instruction: Thaw primary human brain microvessel endothelial cells in a 37 °C water bath for 1 min, spray the vial with 70 % ethanol and wipe, transfer to 9 mL pre‑warmed medium in a 50‑mL tube, centrifuge 450 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant, resuspend in 10 mL medium, count cells, discard PBS(–) from the collagen‑I‑coated dish, seed ~1 × 10⁶ cells in 8 mL medium, incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ (do not disturb for ≥1 h), change medium every 2–3 days and passage at 70–80 % confluence (1:4 split, ≤8 passages).

substeps.instruction: Place the frozen cryovial in a 37 °C water bath for 1 min.
Spray the vial with 70 % ethanol and wipe it off carefully.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 50 mL centrifuge tube containing 9 mL pre‑warmed EGM2‑MV medium.
Centrifuge at 450 × g for 5 min and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 10 mL pre‑warmed medium and count the cells.
Remove PBS(–) from the collagen‑I‑coated 100‑mm dish prepared earlier.
Seed approximately 1 × 10⁶ cells into the dish containing 8 mL medium.
Incubate at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂; avoid disturbing the cells for at least 1 h after seeding.
Change the medium every 2–3 days.
When cultures reach 70–80 % confluence, passage at a 1:4 ratio (do not exceed 8 passages).

steps.title: Configure CQ1 imaging settings
steps.instruction: In the CQ1 software set channel 1 (Hoechst 33342) to 405 nm excitation/447 ± 30 nm emission, channel 2 (WGA AF488) to 488 nm excitation/525 ± 25 nm emission, channel 3 (CellROX orange) to 561 nm excitation/617 ± 36.5 nm emission; set minimum exposure for all channels, binning = 8, 5 fields of view per well, normal‑focus 20× lens, Z‑stack of 5 slices with 3 µm step.

substeps.instruction: Set channel 1: 405 nm excitation, 447/60 nm emission filter for Hoechst 33342.
Set channel 2: 488 nm excitation, 525/50 nm emission filter for WGA AF488.
Set channel 3: 561 nm excitation, 617/73 nm emission filter for CellROX orange.
Set the minimum exposure time for all three channels.
Set image binning to 8.
Select 5 fields of view per well.
Use a normal‑focus 20× magnification objective.
Configure Z‑stack: 5 slices, 3 µm step size.

steps.title: Analyze ROS images with CQ1
steps.instruction: Create analysis objects on CQ1: Object 1 detects nuclei from the Hoechst 33342 MIP, Object 2 detects whole‑cell area from the WGA AF488 MIP; run the analysis on captured images, export results to Excel, extract total CellROX intensity (Object 2 TotalIntensity CH3), cell area (Object 2 area), and optionally cell count (Count), then compute ROS per cell area by dividing intensity by area.

substeps.instruction: Create Object 1 to detect cell nuclei from the maximum‑intensity projection (MIP) of Hoechst 33342 staining.
Create Object 2 to detect the whole‑cell area (including the nucleus) from the MIP of WGA AF488 staining.
Analyze the MIP images using the two objects.
Export the analysis results as an Excel file.
Extract the column “(Object 2) TotalIntensity CH3” for total CellROX fluorescence per cell.
Extract the column “(Object 2) area” for cell area per cell.
If needed, extract the column “Count” for the number of Hoechst‑stained nuclei.
Calculate ROS production per cell area: divide the total CellROX intensity by the corresponding cell area for each cell.

description: Before starting the protocol, prepare the culture of vascular endothelial cells and stock solutions of fluorescent cell membrane marker, reactive oxygen species (ROS) inhibitors, and lipopolysaccharide (LPS). Pause Point: There are no pause points during the three days of the experiment. Before you start, please secure enough time for the experiment.
